notes: Lake Region (a regional conference serving mainly Black and Hispanic congregations in five states) publishes its calendar as a 16-page designed PDF ("2026 Calendar of Events"), read page by page; dates were taken from the calendar grid. It also posts "Coming Events" pages that mix conference events with local-church events (revivals, giveaways, anniversaries); local-church items are kept and marked host:"local church" so they can be filtered out for conference-to-conference comparison. Monthly meetings (children’s ministries, Hispanic SAL, communication training) are listed once with count. Some abbreviations are not explained on the calendar (SAL, NSO Challenge, CLC Lake Union, PARL rally = Public Affairs & Religious Liberty, CFL = basketball league). The Health retreat appears with three different dates across sources (see note on that event). Caution: lrcsda.com page code contains hidden gambling-spam links (site compromise); only visible event content was used.
